card.name: News snippet boundaries and 2011 dates
card.fires_on: The digit 1 in years like 2011 or 2010 in news-feed dates, and the sentence-ending period or first word after a news headline or dateline in science and politics news pages.

modes.label: Year digit
modes.description: The 1 inside a year such as 2011 in a news listing date.
modes.example: ScienceDaily (July 11, 20<<1>>1) — How deep is the ocean

modes.label: Sentence break in news
modes.description: A period ending a news summary or caption, just before the next sentence starts.
modes.example: Ousted IRS chief Steven Miller is sworn in on Capitol Hill Friday<<.>> Miller testified before the House Ways and Means

modes.label: Start of news item
modes.description: The first word of a new item right after a dated headline.
